deadline.value: LTH advertises doctoral positions throughout the year, with no fixed application date.
deadline.quote: LTH does not apply fixed application times, but a doctoral position can be advertised at any time throughout the year

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The LTH pages set no rule on supervisor agreement before admission.

funding.value: LTH says the most common route is employment as a doctoral student, and funding must be secured for the whole education.
funding.quote: The most common form of funding is through employment as a doctoral student

also.quote: For you to be enrolled as a doctoral student, funding is required for your entire education

entry_route.value: Entry needs a second-cycle qualification or 240 credits including 60 at second-cycle level; the subject plan adds at least 90 credits in relevant subjects with 60 at second cycle and a 30-credit degree project, or a relevant second-cycle degree.
entry_route.quote: has been awarded a second-cycle qualification, or

notes: Civil engineering is covered here by the LTH Structural Engineering subject. Water and Environmental Engineering and Geotechnical Engineering are separate LTH subjects and were not saved.
